With Controller 4 Netatmo Presence you get faster access to your Presence in your local network without the cloud. You get many possibilities to control your Presence like:

- Switch for Snapshot and Stream
- Time durance for Snapshot
- Quality for Stream
- Camera on / off
- Floodlight auto / on / off
- Floodlight Intensity

Use the Widget in the Todayview to see who ring the door.

Unfortunally this app is not so easy to configure, because some restrictions and data protection of Netatmo.
If you will use this app you need the secure ID of your camera and you get this information from Netatmo. I provide a video on youtube how it works. 

This app works only with Netatmo Presence devices in wifi.
There is no remote access to your camera.

Applause Meter is an application that works as a measurement instrument that purports to measure and display the volume of clapping or applauses made by an audience using the microphone input. It can be used to indicate the popularity of contestants and decide the result of competitions based on audience popularity.

Perfect for Events, Meetings, Contests, Battle of Bands, Lip-Sync battles and more, the winners may be determined using this App even with a big crowd. You are able to adjust the microphone sensitivity depending on the ambient sound, so the meter didn't max out every time. Use it on Landscape or Portrait (different design for each one). 

Compare and measure applause magnitude adjusting the position of the arrow to the color according to the noise level (decibels):

• Green: TEPID
• Light Green: MILD
• Yellow: SO-SO
• Orange: WILD
• Red: LOUD 

Applause-o-Meter works like a Clap-O-Meter or a Noise-O-Meter with a visual feed back.
